title: SoftWind Bears
description: Adds Grizzly Bears and Panda Bears to Minecraft. Originally made for the SoftWind modpack, but fully usable as a standalone mod.
body:
Adds two new bear mobs to Minecraft.

**Grizzly Bear**
- Spawns in warm taiga biomes
- Neutral mob that can become hostile when provoked
- Drops **Bear Skin** (0–2, affected by Looting)

**Panda Bear**
- Spawns in jungle biomes
- Replaces vanilla pandas

The mod was originally made for the **SoftWind** modpack, but can also be used standalone.

Bear stats and behavior can be configured in `softwindbears-common.toml`.  
Spawn rules are defined via biome modifier datapack JSON and can be overridden with a datapack.
